context_for_next_testing_agent: Finance module completely rewritten in iteration 5. Key changes: 1) Gəlirlər tab now shows companies from /api/companies instead of separate /api/finance/incomes. 2) Summary cards calculated client-side from company data. 3) Note modal calls PUT /api/companies/{id}/finance with {finance_note: text}. 4) Payment edit modal calls same endpoint with {paid_amount: number, last_payment_date: date}. 5) Filters work client-side on allCompanies state. 6) Overview tab shows borclu (debtor) companies sorted by debt. 7) 5 test companies exist in DB with various packages and debt amounts. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5_finance.py with 19 passing tests.

companies_as_income.details: Gəlirlər tab shows all 5 companies from /api/companies. Each row shows: brand_name, owner_name, package, marsol_representative, contract dates, total_amount, paid_amount, debt_amount, finance_note.

finance_filters.details: 4 filters available: Paket, Təmsilçi, Layihə, Status. All filters work correctly. Clear filters button resets all. Filter badge shows active filter count.

finance_search.details: Search bar filters by company name, owner name, or representative. Real-time filtering as user types.

note_modal.details: Click '+ Qeyd əlavə et' or note icon to open modal. Shows company name, textarea, financial summary. Saves via PUT /api/companies/{id}/finance. Success toast shown.

payment_edit_modal.details: Click pencil icon to open modal. Shows total amount (disabled), paid amount input, date picker. Real-time debt recalculation shown. Saves via PUT /api/companies/{id}/finance.

summary_cards.details: 5 cards: Ümumi gəlir (16,500), Ödənilib (8,450), Debitor borc (8,050), Ümumi xərclər (500), Xalis mənfəət (7,950). Calculated from company data.

overview_tab.details: Shows 'Borclu şirkətlər' section with companies sorted by debt (highest first). Shows 'Son xərclər' section with recent expenses.

table_footer.details: Shows totals: Cəmi şirkət count, Məbləğ total, Ödənilib total, Borc total. Updates based on filtered results.

expense_crud.details: Xərc əlavə et button opens expense modal. All fields present: Xərc adı, Kateqoriya, Alt kateqoriya, Məbləğ, Tarix, Layihə, Məsul şəxs.
